home.title: Flagfield
home.heroTitle: Learn countries on a living globe
home.heroSubShort: Globe, map, and flag quiz — short sessions for curious kids and travelers.
home.aboutGameLead: Spin the globe, pan the map, search countries, and check your answer — flags and facts stick faster when you explore.
home.aboutGameP1: Globe Quest and Map Quest: find countries on the 3D globe or flat map. Flag Quiz: recognize flags with four choices. All modes show capitals and continents when you learn.
home.aboutGameP2: Your progress is saved per country — how many times you practiced and what you still mix up.
home.aboutGameP3: Free tier includes {{countries}} countries for flag and capital drills. You can finish {{sessions}} game sessions before Premium is required.
home.aboutGameModesLead: Swipe the mode carousel at the bottom of the Play tab and tap a card to start.
home.aboutGameModesFree: Free drills: pick the country from a flag, find a flag on the map, type the name, and capital quizzes — all use the same {{countries}}-country pool.
home.aboutGameModesQuiz: Knowledge quiz and Facts quiz use only countries and trivia you marked in the Knowledge base.
home.aboutGameModesPath: Learning path is a staged course: flags, capitals, and facts unlock level by level.
home.aboutGameModesPremium: Premium adds Globe Quest (3D globe) and Map Quest (flat political map) with the full catalog.
home.aboutGameKnowledgeP1: Open the Knowledge tab to browse countries by collection. Mark profile fields (capital, language, currency, population) and unique facts with toggles — no play required.
home.aboutGameKnowledgeP2: Countries can sit in your collection, stay partially marked, or remain new. Marked items feed the knowledge and facts quizzes.
home.aboutGameDailyP1: The daily goal counts correct answers today across drills, quizzes, learning path, and premium globe/map (target: {{target}} per day).
home.aboutGameDailyP2: Progress tab shows streak, best day, countries practiced, and knowledge stats. Everything stays on this device.
home.aboutGameAccountP1: Sign in locally to keep progress on this phone or tablet. There is no cloud sync.
home.aboutGameAccountP2: Premium is optional: unlimited sessions plus globe and map quests. Restore purchases from Settings if you reinstall.
home.dailyGoalHint: Any correct answer in a finished play session today (drills, quizzes, learning path, globe, or map).
